messages.author: 7bb41bac0e27b9bf
messages.subject: Min/Max Shapes from allometry - procD.lm
parts:
Hello,

I am enjoying the new geomorph functionality but cannot find out how to get the min and max shapes from the procD.lm() function in order to plot these with plotRefToTarget().
These shapes used to be stored in the output of the model as something like model1$shapes$min...

Specirfically, this is my code:


femur_gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(femGP, SVL = femMetaOrder$SVLmm, habitat=femMetaOrder$habitat, geoName = femMetaOrder$geoName, phyName = femMetaOrder$Phylogeny.name, genSpecies = femMetaOrder$Genspecies)
fit.size.fem <- procD.lm(coords ~ log(Csize), data = femur_gdf)
femSizePlot <- plot(fit.size.fem, type="regression", reg.type = "RegScore", predictor = log(femur_gdf$Csize), shapes = TRUE)


and I would like to make deformed meshes representing the min and max of the allometry with something like 

avgFem <- mshape(femur_gdf$coords)
plotRefToTarget(avgFem, fit.size.fem$shapes$max1)

but I cannot find the shapes and max formats

Thanks very much,

Bob Cieri

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Min/Max Shapes from allometry - procD.lm
parts:
Bob,

for this you will now have to use shape.predictor(). There is an example specifically on allometric models in the help file of that function, so have a look at that.

Cheers,

Antigoni
